dsDescriptionValue.value: Additional file 6: Table S5. Supporting information related to pathway analysis. Genes from ALL vs. pro-B upregulated clusters or up- and downregulated genes in drug vs. ctrl comparisons (related to Figs. 3 and 5) analyzed using Enrichr. Significant terms summarized from GO, MGI Mammalian Phenotype, BioPlanet Reactome and TF perturbations have a combined score > 150. TF motifs from Genome Browser PWMs are listed with nominal p-value
